claim: Hyatt Regency New Brunswick (2 Albany Street) kept in the list as a group D business
problem: Excluded type still present: a branded national chain hotel. The mapper's own notes concede it 'should likely be excluded per the chain rule', but it was not removed.
fix: Delete the entry. If hospitality is in scope, keep only the independent property (The Heldrich) and state the chain screen explicitly.

claim: Barracks Trading Post, 25 US Highway 1 - website given as http://www.barrackstrading-post.com/
problem: Wrong website. The cited site is a Barracks Trading Post in Maple Shade, NJ (856-662-6114, repeated references to 'the Maple Shade community'); it is not the Route 1 New Brunswick store (732-828-0055). The New Brunswick store itself is confirmed by several directories.
fix: Clear the website or replace it with one verified for the Route 1 location; also drop the 'military surplus' description, which no source for the New Brunswick store supports (listings describe electronics/audio resale and repair).

claim: Earth & Ivy, 355 George Street, categorised 'Home decor / gift retail'
problem: Category is wrong. Earth & Ivy at 355 George St is a licensed recreational cannabis dispensary (own site earthandivy.co plus NJ Cannabis Regulatory Commission licence documents).
fix: Re-categorise as cannabis dispensary retail, or drop it if dispensaries are out of scope.

claim: Puffin Store NJ, 382 George Street, categorised 'Vape / smoke retail'
problem: Category is wrong. It is a licensed recreational cannabis dispensary (puffinstorenj.com location page and NJ CRC licence/renewal documents), not a vape/smoke shop.
fix: Re-categorise as cannabis dispensary retail, or drop it if dispensaries are out of scope.

claim: Choice Cleaners, 608 Livingston Avenue, town = New Brunswick
problem: Town attribution is doubtful: directories list 608 Livingston Ave as North Brunswick, NJ 08902, consistent with the mapper's own caveat that Livingston Ave addresses past the line are North Brunswick.
fix: Check the municipal boundary for 608 Livingston Ave; drop the entry or move it to the North Brunswick zone.

claim: Joyeria Minor (163 French St, 732-448-9888) and Minor Gift Shop (163 French St, 848-997-0267)
problem: Probable duplicate. The 163 French Street jewellery business trades as Minor Fine Jewelry / Joyeria Minor (same address, same owning family, different phone), so the same storefront may be listed twice.
fix: Keep one entry (Minor Fine Jewelry, 163 French St) unless a genuinely separate gift shop at that address is confirmed.

claim: New Brunswick Mini Mall, 195 French Street, phone 732-522-6008
problem: Phone conflicts with the French Street business directory, which gives (732) 506-8998 for the same 195 French St store. One of the two numbers is wrong.
fix: Re-check the number against the storefront or a second independent source before outreach.

problem: Contradicted by the company's own contact page, which publishes 732-735-1480 for 28 Paterson St. The listed number is unverified and probably stale. (The bnatbespoke.com website is genuinely this business.)
fix: Use 732-735-1480 and cite https://www.bnathanielbespoke.com/contact, or mark the number unconfirmed.

claim: D&D Fine Cigars, address 9 Elm Row
problem: Its New Brunswick City Center profile says the shop is at 9 Elm Street (phone 973-776-6341 matches). Only the address form differs.
fix: Use the address form published in the City Center listing, or note the variant.

claim: Knights Phone Console Games HDMI Repairs, 304 Handy Street (732-763-0355)
problem: Address conflict: the French Street directory lists 'Knights Phone Repairs' with the same phone at 181 French Street, and 304 Handy Street is also given as International Furniture's address.
fix: Confirm the current storefront (181 French St vs 304 Handy St) before outreach.

claim: White Lotus Home, '745 Joyce Kilmer Avenue (also listed at 191 Hamilton Street)'
problem: Only 191 Hamilton St is documented in the cited directory; the 745 Joyce Kilmer address has no supporting citation in the entry.
fix: Keep 191 Hamilton St as the verified address and remove the unsourced second address unless a source is added.

claim: PRAB Early Childhood Centers entry claims five New Brunswick sites incl. 300 Hoffman Blvd Suite 1 (732-247-5640)
problem: The cited source (NBPS 2025-26 childcare PDF) lists only four PRAB sites: 25 Howard St, 18 Drift St, 411 Joyce Kilmer Ave and 287 Townsend St. The Hoffman Blvd/Raritan Gardens site is not in that document.
fix: Cite a source for the Hoffman Blvd site or trim the entry to the four documented locations.

claim: 'New Brunswick Appliance Repair', 625 Jersey Avenue, phone Unknown
problem: Looks like a lead-generation listing rather than a walk-in business: directories give conflicting phone numbers (732-619-3781 vs 732-791-4928) and none ties to a storefront. Existence as an operating business is unconfirmed.
fix: Drop it or mark it 'unverified - lead-gen listing' so the team does not spend outreach time on it.

claim: Coverage of French Street / Paterson Street retail and services
problem: Several eligible businesses found in independent searches are missing, including Vertigo Vaporium (353 George St), Express Mart & Smoke Shop (30 Paterson St - already on the City Center directory the mapper used), Floreria & Decoracion Cristal (175 French St) and HG Computer Services (132 French St).
fix: Add these after a spot check; the French Street business directory (frenchstreetnj.com/directory) was under-used relative to the City Center site.

claim: Coverage of the NJ Business Directory pages the mapper says were harvested (pp.1-6)
problem: Two eligible listings on those pages were not carried over: Natelson's Inc (Clothing & Boutiques, 10 Jules Ln) and Motion Industries Inc (Manufacturing & Wholesale, 22 Home News Row).
fix: Add them, or record why they were dropped (closed / out of scope).

claim: Church-affiliated and nonprofit rows: Second Reformed Thrift Shop, Mt. Zion CDC Preschool, Catholic Charities ELCs, New Brunswick Bike Exchange
problem: Borderline against the 'worship' exclusion. They are a thrift shop and childcare centres run by congregations/nonprofits, not places of worship, and the mapper flagged the affiliation - but the rules never say whether faith-affiliated nonprofits are in scope.
fix: Write a one-line scope rule and apply it consistently rather than case by case.

claim: Food-production rows: De Stefano Foods, Home-Like Food Co., Mr Ice Bucket, Resnick Distributors
problem: Borderline against the 'food' exclusion. They are manufacturers/distributors, not restaurants or delivery-app shops, and are labelled as such, but a reviewer could read them as excluded.
fix: State explicitly that food manufacturing/wholesale is in scope while food service is not.

claim: Single-source rows resting on truncated map/directory snippets (Dollar Discount, PrimeFix, Southeastern Plastics, Joyeria Minor, Saplings Academy)
problem: These carry truncated phone numbers or no phone and were not independently re-verifiable from an opened page in this check (Saplings Academy in particular could not be confirmed as still operating).
fix: Resolve the truncated numbers where possible (Dollar Discount is 732-214-8858, PrimeFix 732-314-7046) and mark the rest 'unverified' instead of leaving partial numbers.
